---
title: "Sticker Fixture :laugh_cry:"
description: "Titles and descriptions show :thumbs_up: too."
pubDate: 2020-01-02
tags: [StickerTag]
---

Inline :smile: and ==marked :love:== stay in the line, and :thumbs_up::cry: touch.

:angry: :sleep:

:surprise:

Times like 12:30:45 and std::cout, and :nope: keep their colons. A `:smile:` in code stays too.

A stray :foo:grin: still finds the grin.

A meme with a caption shows larger: :rofl:

```text
:smile:
```
